title: Wolf Companion
short: Zero-latency, 100% private conversational AI companion (PWA) executing local LLM inference in-browser via WebGPU.

metrics_matrix.business_roi: 100% Cloud inference cost elimination ($0 ongoing server cost per active user).
metrics_matrix.product_ux: Zero-egress privacy guarantee with full offline conversational functionality on client laptops.
metrics_matrix.system_perf: <15 ms Time to First Token (TTFT) running directly on consumer GPU shaders.
metrics_matrix.eval_quality: Golden eval suite verifying multi-turn coherence and deterministic fallback triggers.

adlc.aim: Problem Discovery: Eliminate ongoing LLM cloud server costs while providing complete client-side data privacy and offline access on consumer laptops.
adlc.data: Designed lightweight calibration prompts, client-side session states, and encrypted user preferences cached locally via IndexedDB.
adlc.develop: Architected WebLLM runtime integration, hardware-accelerated WebGPU fallback cascades, and progressive chunk caching.
adlc.deploy: Shipped as a zero-infrastructure PWA on GitHub Pages with automatic GPU capability detection and model downloading progress UX.
adlc.learn: Measured cold-start model load times across Apple Silicon and Windows GPUs; roadmapped 2-bit quantization for mobile tier devices.

title: SentinelAI
short: Autonomous security triage system contextualizing SIEM alerts, auto-resolving benign noise, and generating audited escalation briefs.

metrics_matrix.business_roi: 65% Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) reduction; reclaims ~4.2 analyst hours per shift.
metrics_matrix.product_ux: Real-time SSE token stream with 1-click explainable rationale and triage decision summaries.
metrics_matrix.system_perf: Sub-50ms streaming token delivery with asynchronous non-blocking SQLite audit logging.
metrics_matrix.eval_quality: 0.0% false-positive auto-resolution rate achieved on high-severity security test suites.

adlc.aim: Solve Tier-1 analyst burnout and sluggish MTTR by automating high-volume false positive triage with explainable decision rationales.
adlc.data: Created sanitized JSON schema contracts for telemetry feeds and simulated MCP connectors with strict data redaction layers.
adlc.develop: Engineered backend safety guardrails, Server-Sent Events (SSE) token streaming, and an immutable SQLite audit log storing prompt fingerprints.
adlc.deploy: Docker Compose multi-service architecture ready for 1-click cloud provisioning and future Wazuh SIEM webhook integration.
adlc.learn: Iteratively tuned confidence thresholds with security analysts to maintain a 0.0% false-resolution rate on critical incident vectors.

title: Legal LLM Quantizer
short: Air-gapped containerized pipeline compressing open LLMs to 4-bit precision for high-compliance legal firms with SHA256 chain-of-custody.

metrics_matrix.business_roi: Saves $45k/yr per firm in multi-GPU cloud infrastructure by enabling single-GPU on-prem inference.
metrics_matrix.product_ux: Zero data egress compliance clearance for high-stakes NDA client contracts and legal discovery.
metrics_matrix.system_perf: 70% VRAM compression ratio (16-bit 26GB compressed to 4-bit 7.8GB footprint).
metrics_matrix.eval_quality: <1.2% perplexity drift on legal corpora with cryptographic SHA256 artifact verification.

adlc.aim: Allow law firms with strict NDAs and zero data-egress policies to run advanced 13B+ LLMs on economical on-premise hardware.
adlc.data: Compiled representative calibration corpora from open legal contracts and statutes to prevent domain precision loss during quantization.
adlc.develop: Built automated GPTQ 4-bit quantization passes, config-driven pipeline runners, and cryptographic SHA256 artifact hashing.
adlc.deploy: Docker Compose stack configured for air-gapped offline networks with GGUF export options for local llama.cpp serving.
adlc.learn: Evaluated post-compression perplexity and citation accuracy against 16-bit baselines to verify zero legal comprehension drift.

title: Wolf SaaS Dashboard

metrics_matrix.business_roi: Cuts prototype validation cycles from weeks to hours by providing an instant multi-persona AI sandbox.
metrics_matrix.product_ux: Ultra-smooth chunked streaming interface with cancel/abort controls and session memory.
metrics_matrix.system_perf: <50ms Time to First Token with live streaming token-per-second throughput telemetry.
metrics_matrix.eval_quality: Persona routing benchmarked across 4 local model families with structured output validation.

adlc.aim: Provide a high-throughput, low-latency streaming user interface for benchmarking multi-persona AI applications with local inference engines.
adlc.data: Dynamic prompt interpolation, system persona definitions, and stateful session memory storage.
adlc.develop: Built chunked token streaming, user persona controls, abort/cancel controls, and multi-session state management.
adlc.deploy: Containerized stack configured for local development and secure LAN/mobile testing.
adlc.learn: Instrumented Time to First Token (TTFT) and token-per-second throughput metrics to guide front-end buffering strategies.

title: Pandemic ETL Pipeline
